meta.name: understand-onboard
meta.description: Use when you need to generate an onboarding guide for new team members joining a project

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成新成员快速上手的入门指南
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 需要帮新成员快速上手项目
copy.tagline_en: Generate a quick-start guide for new team members
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're welcoming new teammates and want them up to speed fast.

howto.what: 读取项目知识图谱(.understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json),为新人生成一份 markdown 上手指南,包含项目概览、架构分层、关键概念、分步导览、文件地图和复杂度热点,并询问是否保存到 docs/ONBOARDING.md。
howto.when: 当你要为加入项目的新成员生成上手指南时接管;前提是知识图谱文件已存在,若没有会先让你运行 /understand。

say.text: 把这份上手指南保存到 docs/ONBOARDING.md
say.note: 写入文件,方便提交给团队

say.text: 生成指南,并标出复杂度热点部分

howto.what_en: Reads the project knowledge graph and generates a markdown onboarding guide with project overview, architecture layers, key concepts, guided tour, file map and complexity hotspots; offers to save it to docs/ONBOARDING.md.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need an onboarding guide for new team members joining a project; the knowledge graph must already exist, otherwise it asks you to run /understand first.
